o.text: Ultimately from Arabic شَيْء (šayʔ). For the “penis” sense development compare Turkish şey, Armenian բան (ban).
From axmaq (“to flow”) + -ış. Cognate with Turkish akış.
Ultimately from Proto-Oghuz *āt- (“to step”). Cognate to Turkish atlamak, Turkmen ätlemek, Salar atlağusı, etc.
Borrowed from Persian سحرباز (sehrbâz). By surface analysis, sehr + -baz.
